text_blocks.snippet: Maryland DUI penalties vary based on the number of prior offenses and whether a minor was in the vehicle. First-time DUI convictions can lead to up to one year in jail and a $1,000 fine, with doubled penalties for transporting a minor. Subsequent offenses carry increased jail time and fines, and may also include mandatory jail time. All DUI convictions result in license suspension and points on the driver's record.
